held_out_use: Reserve during development and fitting. Freeze policy and conditions before first use; later reuse is regression evidence.
bias_frame: arm base; rotation changes position about base origin and object orientation
noise: Independent Gaussian position and rotation-vector components, with separate seeded streams; resample once per delivered observation timestamp
delay: Latest captured pose at or before now-delay; log effective age and startup warmup; no interpolation
tolerance: Largest tested magnitude with at least 18/20 true successes in every tested direction at that and all lower levels; report counts, uncertainty and scope. No untested or physical tolerance claims.
